title: ClaimRecord
description: Schema for a claim extracted during research. Claims are the atomic units of evidence that populate the final report. Stored in claims.jsonl.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for this claim. Format: claim-NNN.

claim_text.description: The factual assertion or recommendation text.

source_ids.description: Source IDs that support this claim. Must reference existing source records.

confidence.description: Confidence level of this claim based on source quality and agreement.

status.description: Status of this claim in the research process.

section.description: Intended report section for this claim.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this claim was first recorded.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this claim was verified against sources.
